description: This file contains utility methods for database operations related to Admin objects, including validation, retrieval, addition, update, and deletion of admin records.
external_files: Assumed to be a class providing executeSearch and executeIUD database methods

classes.name: AdminDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for admin-related database operations.

methods.name: validateAdmin
methods.description: Validates an admin's email and password against the database; returns an Admin object if valid, null otherwise.

methods.name: getAllAdmins
methods.description: Retrieves all admin records from the database and returns a list of Admin objects.

methods.name: addAdmin
methods.description: Inserts a new admin record into the database with provided details.

methods.name: updateAdmin
methods.description: Updates an existing admin's details in the database, identified by AID.

methods.name: deleteAdmin
methods.description: Deletes an admin record from the database by AID.

methods.name: updateAdminWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates admin details excluding the image URL, identified by AID.
